title: Mesh and time-step sensitivity of the hardware winner
author: KSam37
question: Does the rod-campaign 1 Hz winner (0.5 mm sheet + 5/3 mm rod, 2.33 N at 0.98 N·m on 8 × 4 panels and 50 steps per cycle) keep its thrust and stay within the 1 N·m budget when the spanwise mesh and the time step are both refined?
notes: The first case repeats the campaign's own numerics, so it should reproduce the atlas value; the other three show how far the result moves under refinement.
